WITH jan_2024_users AS (
  SELECT id, created_at
  FROM public.users
  WHERE created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND created_at < '2024-02-01'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    u.id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.order_id END) as non_cancelled_order_count
  FROM jan_2024_users u
  LEFT JOIN public.order_items oi ON oi.user_id = u.id
    AND oi.created_at >= u.created_at 
    AND oi.created_at < u.created_at + INTERVAL '90 days'
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY u.id
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE non_cancelled_order_count >= 2)::double precision / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0))::numeric, 4) AS share
FROM user_orders

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY oi.created_at) AS order_rank
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN facebook_users fu ON oi.user_id = fu.id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id, oi.created_at
),
first_second_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    created_at,
    order_rank
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE order_rank IN (1, 2)
),
order_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN created_at END) AS first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN order_rank = 2 THEN created_at END) AS second_order_date
  FROM first_second_orders
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_date::date - first_order_date::date))::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM order_pairs

  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'

  END) AS users_with_order,
  ROUND((COUNT(DISTINCT CASE 
    WHEN oi.order_id IS NOT NULL AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'

WITH facebook_users AS (
  SELECT id FROM public.users WHERE traffic_source = 'Facebook'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY MIN(oi.created_at)) AS order_num
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.user_id IN (SELECT id FROM facebook_users)
    AND oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.user_id, oi.order_id
),
second_third_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_num,
    order_date
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE order_num IN (2, 3)
),
days_between AS (
  SELECT 
    u2.user_id,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM (u3.order_date - u2.order_date)) AS days_diff
  FROM (SELECT user_id, order_date FROM second_third_orders WHERE order_num = 2) u2
  JOIN (SELECT user_id, order_date FROM second_third_orders WHERE order_num = 3) u3
    ON u2.user_id = u3.user_id
)
SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_diff)::numeric, 2) AS median_days
FROM days_between

  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'

),
first_second_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    user_id,
    order_id,
    created_at,
    order_sequence
  FROM user_orders
  WHERE order_sequence IN (1, 2)
),
order_pairs AS (
  SELECT 
    f.user_id,
    f.created_at AS first_order_date,
    s.created_at AS second_order_date,
    (s.created_at::date - f.created_at::date) AS days_between
  FROM first_second_orders f
  JOIN first_second_orders s ON f.user_id = s.user_id 
    AND f.order_sequence = 1 
    AND s.order_sequence = 2
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between) AS median_days

WITH order_values AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.order_id,
    oi.user_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN oi.status <> 'Cancelled' THEN oi.sale_price ELSE 0 END) AS order_value,
    MIN(oi.created_at) AS order_date
  FROM public.order_items oi
  WHERE oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01' AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY oi.order_id, oi.user_id
),
first_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    ov.user_id,
    ov.order_id,
    ov.order_value,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ov.user_id ORDER BY ov.order_date ASC) AS order_rank
  FROM order_values ov
),
classified_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE WHEN order_rank = 1 THEN 'first' ELSE 'repeat' END AS order_type,
    order_value
  FROM first_orders
),
medians AS (
  SELECT 
    order_type,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY order_value) AS median_order_value
  FROM classified_orders
  GROUP BY order_type
)
SELECT 
  ROUND((
    (SELECT median_order_value FROM medians WHERE order_type = 'first') - 
    (SELECT median_order_value FROM medians WHERE order_type = 'repeat')
  )::numeric, 2) AS difference

    order_id,

  WHERE status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND created_at < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY user_id, order_id, created_at
),
first_second_orders AS (

    MAX(CASE WHEN order_sequence = 2 THEN created_at END) AS second_order_date

  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN order_sequence = 1 THEN created_at END) IS NOT NULL

  SELECT 
    user_id,
    EXTRACT(DAY FROM second_order_date - first_order_date)::integer AS days_between
  FROM first_second_orders

SELECT ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY days_between)::numeric, 2) AS percentile_95

WITH search_users AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM public.users
  WHERE traffic_source = 'Search'
),
user_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    oi.user_id,
    oi.order_id,
    oi.created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY oi.user_id ORDER BY oi.created_at ASC) as order_sequence
  FROM public.order_items oi
  JOIN search_users su ON su.id = oi.user_id
  WHERE oi.status <> 'Cancelled'
    AND oi.created_at >= '2024-01-01'
    AND oi.created_at < '2025-01-01'
),
distinct_orders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    user_id,
    order_id,
    created_at,
    order_sequence
  FROM user_orders
),
orders_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    order_id,
    created_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY created_at ASC) as rank
  FROM distinct_orders
),
first_second_orders AS (
  SELECT
    user_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 1 THEN created_at END) as first_order_date,
    MAX(CASE WHEN rank = 2 THEN created_at END) as second_order_date
  FROM orders_ranked
  WHERE rank <= 2
  GROUP BY user_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 2
)
SELECT
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (second_order_date - first_order_date))) / 86400) as median_days
FROM first_second_orders
